signature: explodeFloor(opts?: { gap?: number; axis?: 'x' | 'y' | 'z'; durationMs?: number }): void

params.name: axis
params.desc: 炸开方向 'y' (垂直) / 'x' / 'z', 默认 'y'

params.name: durationMs
params.desc: 动画过渡毫秒数, 0 = 立刻

code: const gap = params.gap ?? 20; const axis = params.axis ?? 'y'; const durationMs = params.durationMs ?? 600; ssp.objectsTool.explodeFloor({ gap, axis, durationMs }); return { message: '楼层已炸开', exploded: ssp.objectsTool.isExploded(), gap, axis, durationMs };
guard: 需所有楼层 root 都有 userData.level 数字 (我们的 GLB 已注入)
